correctness.rationale: Cycle-vertex incidence forest makes cycle characteristic relations linearly independent and excludes unit vectors. The matroid closure contains each cycle-generation step. In the opposite direction, for any cycle-closed T, a quotient dependence with precisely one outside coordinate can be pruned from farthest selected leaf cycles toward that outside vertex; closedness forces each pruned cycle to be internal to T, and the final incident cycle contradicts closedness. Thus closures coincide for all subsets; nonloop vector-matroid independence yields all three maxima n-c and basis exchange. Direct checker exhausts labelled connected cacti up to six vertices (6075 total across orders 1..6), plus 200 sampled larger graphs. A diamond witnesses the noncactus boundary.
